title: hotfix: stabilize-slo-enforcer-backoff-regional-thrashing-stability
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: In production on 2026-02-14 we observed repeated regional failover thrashing during a traffic spike. The SLO enforcer's backoff/re-enable logic was oscillating (open -> closed -> open) causing cascading failovers and client-visible elevated latency. Root cause: race between priority-queue reordering and the backoff counter reset path, combined with insufficient hysteresis and overly-aggressive re-enable thresholds. This PR introduces a targeted hotfix to stabilize backoff behavior under contention. Changes: 1) add stronger hysteresis window configurable per-region; 2) make backoff state transitions atomic (centralize in backoff_manager); 3) introduce a token-bucket style rate limiter for re-enable attempts to avoid fast oscillation; 4) add quorum-based soft-ack for regional re-enable when controller sees flapping; 5) expose metrics/tags for backoff_state, hysteresis_window_ms, reenable_rate_limited; 6) tighten default thresholds for older clients and legacy routing; 7) add unit/integration tests that simulate failover thrashing. Testing & CI: unit tests added for backoff state machine and queue ordering; an integration test simulates cross-region spikes and verifies no more than one re-enable per 30s per-region under sustained failures; local load tests reproduce previous thrash pattern and show stable behavior after changes. Rollout: hotfix will be deployed to canary (us-east-1) for 2 hours, then staged to 25% traffic for 1 hour, then promoted to full. Rollback: feature flag "slo_enforcer_hysteresis_v2" allows immediate rollback; revert path documented. Checklist: - [x] Reproduced thrashing locally and in staging - [x] Unit & integration tests added - [x] Metrics and logs instrumented - [x] Config knobs documented in infra helm values - [x] Canary deployment plan created - [x] Linked Linear tickets (ENG-2045, ENG-2072) updated Related: ENG-2045 (postmortem), SUP-9123 (customer report).

--- a/infra/helm/slo-enforcer/values.yaml
+++ b/infra/helm/slo-enforcer/values.yaml
@@
+sloEnforcer:
+  hysteresisWindowMs: 30000
+  reenableRate: 1 # permits 1 re-enable per 30s by default
+  featureFlags:
+    slo_enforcer_hysteresis_v2: true

release_notes:
- Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff/re-enable to prevent regional failover thrashing.
- Added configurable hysteresis_window_ms and rate limiting for re-enable attempts.
- Exposed backoff metrics for easier diagnosis.
- Rollout plan included (canary -> 25% -> full) and feature flag for immediate rollback.
